questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?
questions.rationale: The request explicitly specifies a React + TypeScript foundation.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for a maintainable frontend.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and build/styling tools should be used?
questions.rationale: The request explicitly specifies React, Vite, and Tailwind.

options.label: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS
options.description: The requested React and TypeScript app foundation, built with Vite and styled with Tailwind CSS.

questions.question: What should the frontend foundation include?
questions.answer: Mobile-first premium motorcycle/automotive e-commerce UI for Pakistan using PKR; text-only branding; routes /, /shop, /product/:slug, /cart, /checkout, /login, /signup, /account, /orders, /admin, /admin/products, /admin/orders, /admin/suppliers, and /admin/agents; reusable components, routing, environment/config structure, and basic error/loading handling. Exclude AI agents, Supabase connection/schema implementation (future-ready environment structure only if needed), Alibaba, WhatsApp, payment, supplier, and support integrations, automatic purchasing, fake customer data, and API integrations.
questions.rationale: These capabilities, routes, and exclusions are explicitly specified in the request.
questions.recommendedChoice: Mobile-first premium motorcycle/automotive e-commerce UI for Pakistan using PKR; text-only branding; routes /, /shop, /product/:slug, /cart, /checkout, /login, /signup, /account, /orders, /admin, /admin/products, /admin/orders, /admin/suppliers, and /admin/agents; reusable components, routing, environment/config structure, and basic error/loading handling. Exclude AI agents, Supabase connection/schema implementation (future-ready environment structure only if needed), Alibaba, WhatsApp, payment, supplier, and support integrations, automatic purchasing, fake customer data, and API integrations.

questions.question: Which data stores does this project need in this phase?
questions.rationale: This phase is a frontend foundation and explicitly excludes API integrations and Supabase implementation.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: No database, file/object storage, queue, or cache is needed for this UI-only foundation.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Relational database for persistent application data.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for uploaded or served files and media.

questions.question: Will users sign in to access application API features in this phase?
questions.rationale: Login and signup are requested as UI routes, while API integrations and authentication implementation are excluded.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users authenticate to access API-backed application features.

options.label: No
options.description: No API-backed sign-in is part of this phase.
